Miserable condition of Panathur-Belagere Road Railway Underpass Panathur, due to its proximity to Whitefield and Sarjapura, has seen rapid growth in the last 2 years and is now filled with commercial properties and apartment complexes. All told there should be more than 15000 flats. Being extremely narrow, this road can barely handle two-way traffic. It is filled with garbage and potholes and is perpetually being dug up on some pretext. The icing on the cake is a narrow railway vent at the end of this stretch which allows only one-way traffic to commute at a time. The menace on the Panathur-Belagere Road begins even before sunrise at times and continues for the rest of the day. Over 20,000 vehicles pass through this road daily where only one side is let to travel at a time. The presence of a large number of water tankers only adds to the chaos as these tanker drivers rush along with a complete disregard for traffic or rules. Making matters worse, the traffic on the Panathur-Belagere Road is not being managed by the city’s traffic police. This Herculean task falls to private security guards deployed by some IT companies. Many people don’t conform to the guard’s instructions as they have no legal power to penalize anyone. The residents of Panathur have been waiting for years, in suspended animation, hoping to see a ray of light in what seems to be a never-ending tunnel of darkness.
